@[fun_prop]
lemma ContinuousOn.sup' (hf : ContinuousOn f s) (hg : ContinuousOn g s) :
    ContinuousOn (f ⊔ g) s := fun x hx ↦
  (hf x hx).sup' (hg x hx)

@[fun_prop]
lemma ContinuousOn.sup (hf : ContinuousOn f s) (hg : ContinuousOn g s) :
    ContinuousOn (fun a ↦ f a ⊔ g a) s :=
  hf.sup' hg

hf.inf' hg

@[fun_prop]
lemma ContinuousOn.inf' (hf : ContinuousOn f s) (hg : ContinuousOn g s) :
    ContinuousOn (f ⊓ g) s := fun x hx ↦
  (hf x hx).inf' (hg x hx)

@[fun_prop]
lemma ContinuousOn.inf (hf : ContinuousOn f s) (hg : ContinuousOn g s) :
    ContinuousOn (fun a ↦ f a ⊓ g a) s :=
  hf.inf' hg
